Rustic Well
Allow Underground Wells
If enabled, players can build/place wells in underground. Disable to restrict well placement to ground level.
Allow Well Contamination
If enabled, wells can become contaminated if there are dead bodies nearby, making the water unsafe to drink. This adds a layer of risk to well placement and maintenance.
Charcoal Needed per Liter
The amount of charcoal needed to clean one liter of water from the well. Higher values require more charcoal for cleaning water.
Contamination Chance per Body
The chance (as a percentage) that each dead body within the contamination radius will contribute to contaminating the well.
Maximum Water per Cycle
The maximum amount of water (in units) the well will produce per refill cycle.
Minimum Hours with Bodies to Contaminate
The minimum number of hours that dead bodies need to be present within the contamination radius of a well in order for it to become contaminated.
Minimum Water per Cycle
The minimum amount of water (in units) the well will produce per refill cycle.
My Own Well
Well Contamination Radius
The radius (in tiles) around a well within which dead bodies can contaminate the water.
Min Distance Between Wells to Refill
Minimum distance (in tiles) required between wells in order for them to fully refill. Prevents clustering multiple wells too close together for resource gain.
Water Refill Multiplier
Multiplier applied to the water refill rate of the well. Higher values increase the total water generated per cycle.
Rain Water Bonus
Additional multiplier applied to the water refill rate of the well when it is raining. This simulates the effect of rainwater contributing to the well's water supply.
